worker-dialler.cdx.json.gz":"sha256:ff3811d6af9979f0006dbf9e012108537721c5bcdf4803beceaca0d6d2560305","sbom-worker-imports.cdx.json.gz":"sha256:fceb58e39521084e70617e4f4ef36fef897cb0c52a209a9be977f161eabfa0c8","sbom-worker-relay.cdx.json.gz":"sha256:e57d1adc39ed9cd588bac1e97ca8157abef592339bcb46097b3f356cc9d56edc","sbom-worker-routing.cdx.json.gz":"sha256:5e768f0578d69804b14cbe826a830248584db14101ac0add8f4c083bf89a2174","sbom-worker-telephony.cdx.json.gz":"sha256:8919e7f7edc7e690880d5f25f970d201eb0dfb57adcb1e432b106816e10c22ae","sbom-worker-webhooks.cdx.json.gz":"sha256:5b26ed4b8910a1c1fe074615a23da2069e552522925cc7236374212f30e7cc46"},"notes":"Imara CX phase 2 for the Imara edition: paid packages, a prepaid balance, invoices with VAT, voice providers and a number shop. Yaxxa installations see no change unless the edition is set to imara.

Paid packages: an Imara customer can buy a package and pay by card through Paystack. Packages renew on their date, and a customer can change or cancel from the billing page.

Prepaid balance: customers top up a balance, with an optional automatic top-up when it runs low, and calls and other usage are taken from it. A customer sees the balance, top-ups and usage on the billing page.

Invoices and failed payments: every payment produces an invoice with VAT. When a card payment fails the customer is walked through the retry steps and reminded, and the account is limited only after the last step. Emergency calls always go through, whatever is unpaid or blocked.

Outbound guard: outbound calls stop when the balance is empty or the account is blocked, and are allowed again once the customer pays.

Voice providers: calls and numbers can be supplied through NTT and AVOXI.

Number shop: customers pick and order numbers in the app. Numbers that need identity and address documents go through KYC; the new Number admin platform role fulfils orders and opens those documents.

Trial data deletion and Starter allowances: a trial that ends without paying has its data deleted after the notice period, while invoices are kept. Starter customers get a small taste of the paid features within set allowances.

Yaxxa: nothing changes unless the edition is imara. Shared changes Yaxxa operators should know: deleting a tenant now keeps its invoices, lines, payments and billing events for five years (empty on Yaxxa today, so the result is the same). Platform permissions numbers.read, numbers.manage and numbers.kyc are new, with a new Number admin role. The Billing and Read-only roles gained the numbers permissions that match what they could already do with numbers, so their access is unchanged."}
